WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT 
    o.recordvault as ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as order_avg_fill
  FROM orders o
  JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan
),
timespan_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as timespan_avg_fill
  FROM orders o
  JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    of.ordersmark,
    of.timespan,
    of.order_avg_fill,
    ta.timespan_avg_fill,
    of.order_avg_fill - ta.timespan_avg_fill as excess
  FROM order_fills of
  JOIN timespan_avgs ta ON of.timespan = ta.timespan
  WHERE of.order_avg_fill > ta.timespan_avg_fill
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    timespan,
    order_avg_fill,
    excess,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY order_avg_fill DESC) as rank_within_timespan
  FROM filtered_orders
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  order_avg_fill,
  excess,
  rank_within_timespan
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE rank_within_timespan <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, rank_within_timespan
